title: Deleted Mailboxes and the Renewed Seats of a Professional Email Reactivation
content:
Mailbox administration guide, renewed seats. On a Professional Email reactivation renewal the renewed seats — the seats the reactivation renewal bills — turn on the idle seats of the current term.

**Idle seats.** The idle seats of a reactivation renewal are the mailbox deletions recorded on the subscription in the current term less the restores of those deletions, a deletion counting in the current term, and its restore with it, where the whole calendar months from the deletion date to today are no more than the whole calendar months from the term start date to today.

**Renewed seats.**
- Where a scheduled seat count is set, the renewed seats are the lower of the scheduled seat count and the seat count on the subscription, but never fewer than the mailboxes in use, the seat count less the idle seats.
- Where no scheduled seat count is set and the idle seats are above zero, they are the seat count less the idle seats.
- Otherwise they are the seat count on the subscription, every licensed seat being billed.

## Which deletions count (hypothetical term start 10 March, today 25 August: 5 whole calendar months)

| Deletion date | Whole calendar months to 25 August | Counts in the current term |
|---|---|---|
| 18 April | 4 | yes |
| 26 February | 5 | yes |
| 24 February | 6 | no |

## Renewed seats (hypothetical seat count 37, idle seats 4)

| Scheduled seat count | Renewed seats |
|---|---|
| none | 37 less 4, that is 33 |
| 30 | the lower of 30 and 37 is 30, but never fewer than 33 in use: 33 |
| 35 | the lower of 35 and 37 is 35, not fewer than 33: 35 |
| none, with idle seats 0 | 37 |
